text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jewellery worth more than 1.5 million dinars is expected to change hands at an Indian exhibition being held in Bahrain. Jewellery worth $10 million is on display.
- Bahrain Telecommunications Co is to cut charges on direct international telephone calls by up to 45 percent from March 1.
- Five-star hotels' net profits are expected to drop due to competition and a decline in business.
- Electricity minister says Arab countries would spend $10 billion a year on electricity projects in the next century.
